scope: Modern adapter PLOTSETTINGS/LAYOUT/VIEWPORT admitted binding state, staged fields and actual emitted provider identities. No core parser/public API or support-ledger changes.

baseline.failure: Post-preflight dangling page shade target was published
developmentFailures: The first integer comparator rejected the writer's padded ASCII integer value; accept ASCII integer whitespace without conflating subclass scopes.
An expanded test build failed -Werror=misleading-indentation. Its subsequent stale-binary output was excluded; correct the source and require successful owning builds before qualification.

The initial VisualStyle observer counted AcDbEntity's full-VisualStyle 348 as AcDbViewport's separate 348. Scope only the consumer field; common entity-role semantics/remapping remain in the full dependency queue.

sources.use: PLOTSETTINGS 76 is the shade mode and 333 is the optional shade handle. Its generic table lists modes 0..3; this does not qualify mode4/5 producer semantics.
LAYOUT embeds AcDbPlotSettings, while AcDbLayout has a separate UCS code76, paper BLOCK_RECORD330, last-active331 and shade333. Field scope must be retained.
VIEWPORT shade170/333 and visual-style348. Generic published shade modes remain 0..3; local adapter modes4/5 are exercised without promoting native wire support.
Independent project documentation corroborates viewport/layout separation and scoped viewport shade/visual-style fields; it is not a native CAD acceptance receipt.

implementation: Snapshot admitted PLOTSETTINGS, LAYOUT and VIEWPORT binding fields and provider type/owner before callbacks. Check actual live state again at staged inspection and finalization, including collection removal/addition and generation changes.

Use bounded shared record framing and scope-aware primitive comparisons for consumer self/owner, plot76 versus viewport170, shade333 and AcDbViewport348. Ignore application-local groups and keep AcDbEntity full-VisualStyle handling separate.

Resolve provider identities and owners against actual staged record inventory at finalization; nonanonymous viewport sources must also have the real source-to-emitted entity binding. Anonymous viewports use retained section order plus actual output identity/owner/scalars; no original-source identity certificate is invented.

Preserve direct dxfRW/interface users without an adapter export plan, legacy version behavior, and inactive 2D streaming. Do not enable otherwise-unused inspection/record inventory for an unbound viewport-only input; retain final live-state checks.

Index providers lazily to avoid per-consumer full provider scans. Limit retained rows to100000 and64MiB logical row/name/index allowance; cap transient provider indexing at200000 records. These bounds do not establish RSS/allocator-capacity/performance.

controls.presetProfiles: Ten existing canonical preset bodies in ASCII/binary AC1027; existing independent body proofs remain unchanged.
controls.additionalProfiles: Named-block and anonymous viewports, provider/consumer fixed-ID collisions, scoped application metadata, selected AC1021/AC1024/AC1032 outputs, valid alternate-preset rebinding and VisualStyle consumer fields.
controls.callbackPhases: Header-time edits, temporary emission edits restored before inspection, persistent post-OBJECTS edits and finalizer-time edits. Mode/target/identity/owner edits and collection removals; extra emitted page/layout/viewport records.
controls.faultScope: Allocation failure is armed only around the actual new finalizer helper from the real adapter finalization callback. Each reached fault must refuse before publication and preserve the sentinel; every unreached offset must export. Reuse the adapter for correction; stop after two consecutive unreached offsets, bounded by256 per encoding.

packaging.scope: Source archive regeneration and exact byte inventory; no repeated extracted-source compilation claim.

validation.warningPolicy: Retain strict configured warnings/-Werror, the existing frozen-parser GNU exception, and the qualified Debug/-O1 ASan profile. No change to original Debug/O0 ASan configuration.

limits: Selected locally authored modern output transport, scoped fields and identity evidence do not prove all producer/version profiles, rendering interpretation or native CAD/kernel acceptance.
The generic Autodesk shade tables still omit SDK/adapter modes4/5; actual independent VIEWPORT wire witnesses/spec reconciliation remain open. Existing local behavior is tested, not promoted.

AcDbEntity full-VisualStyle/common entity fields, arbitrary remaps, other entity dependencies and unknown application semantics remain in the full dependency queue. Only the separate AcDbViewport348 is bound here.

Edited RenderSettings body rewriting remains unqualified; valid pre-export consumer target/mode edits are supported at the recorded scope. This does not complete emitted dictionaries, recursive/coupled ownership or whole-document output eligibility.
Inactive 2D viewports preserve the ordinary path and receive frozen live-state checks; they do not receive a new emitted byte certificate. Direct codecs and legacy versions retain their prior route.
Archive regeneration proves exact inclusion of final inputs; source-release builds from RPP-5fx remain their own checkpoint, not a fresh extracted-source compilation claim for this runtime change.

Logical caps and finite fault schedules do not prove allocator capacity, peak RSS or controlled performance. Native Linux/Windows, formal ABI, independent kernel evidence and external support gates remain separate.
